span.p:
ε rising: machines take more,
human labor shrinks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Physical State
capital_stock · ecosystem_health
age_distribution · knowledge_base_size

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Personal EOH
population × age-weighted
~1500 h/person/yr
biology does not change with ε

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Infrastructure EOH
capital_stock × age_factor
× maint_rate
grows as civilization builds

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ecological EOH
base/ecosystem_health
+ nonlinear threshold spike
+ monitoring-visible deferred

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Knowledge EOH
kbs × complexity × decay
dominant at ε → 0.99
hardest to verify

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
total_eoh = P + I + E + K
entropy obligation of civilization

span.p:
Personal domain
personal_eoh_registration_share(ε)
near-zero at ε=0
off-ledger subsistence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Other domains
total_registration_share(ε)
labor composite sigmoid

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
registered_eoh
= human_eoh × registration_share
EOH admitted to the collective ledger

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
teh_created
= registered_eoh × mean_multiplier
TEH enters circulation
